new_value: Fixed (commit, lichen/apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c): the root DIO now advertises the SCHC Rule Version option (spec 5.7 R-03-048, option 0x13) — (1) removed the duplicated 'uint8_t src[16], dst[16]' declaration (the committed duplicate was a real compile error; gateway builds were red), (2) enlarged the DIO buffer by the 3-byte option (2-byte header + LICHEN_RPL_SCHC_RULE_VERSION_DATA_LEN=1), (3) appends lichen_rpl_schc_rule_version_write with version = LICHEN_SCHC_RULE_SET_VERSION (3) after the DODAG Config option and includes it in rpl_body_len/ICMPv6 length/checksum. C RX admission (dodag.c: requires have_schc_version && version == 3) is now satisfiable by the root's own DIOs. Verification: cppcheck clean on rpl_root.c; full gateway build validation deferred — the shared heft workspace has a pre-existing WIFI/NRF70 Kconfig dependency loop and the zcbor Kconfig loop that block ALL gateway app builds locally (both documented workspace limitations, unrelated to this change; the duplicate-decl fix means the gateway was committed-red before). CI ec2-arm64 gateway build is the green gate. Codereview: cppcheck + targeted inspection; the change is a 20-line mechanical serialization fix with the RX contract verified against dodag.c:669-676 (version must equal LICHEN_SCHC_RULE_SET_VERSION).
